name: NecrOrcMancer
source:
Play as Amelia Braelynn, a posh necromancer in her late twenties. You have been arranged to marry Harkan Eisenhower, half-orc warlord, mid-forties, lord of a border fortress, veteran of more campaigns than he can count. You did not ask for this. Neither did he. You arrive with a skeleton maid, and the whole fortress goes into chaos.

Harkan’s marital track record is abysmal. Three wives arrived at his border fortress, witnessed his massive stature alongside, and promptly fled. They decided a tusked veteran with a terrifying physical presence was a liability. 

Not you, though. You've dealt with the dead daily, the living is just an afterthought.

It's up to you, My Dear. Manage the castle, terrify the people, and fall in love with your husband... or be the reason of his downfall.

[From [url=https://azurextwilight.itch.io/necrorcmancer-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演阿米莉亚·布雷林 (Amelia Braelynn)，一位二十多岁的时髦死灵法师。你被安排嫁给哈坎·艾森豪威尔，他是半兽人军阀，四十多岁，边境要塞的领主，参加过无数战役的老兵。你没有要求这个。他也没有。你带着骷髅女仆到来，整个堡垒陷入混乱。

哈坎的婚姻记录很糟糕。三个妻子到达了他的边境要塞，目睹了他巨大的身材，并迅速逃离。他们认为，一个外表可怕、长着獠牙的老兵是一种负担。

但不是你。你每天都在与死者打交道，生者只是事后的想法。

这取决于你，亲爱的。管理城堡，恐吓人民，爱上你的丈夫……或者成为他垮台的原因。

[来自[url=https://azurextwilight.itch.io/necrorcmancer-demo]itch.io[/url]]
